units: all lengths normalized by torso length (hull diameter over tail/chest/backtop/belly landmarks, study definition)

neck_chain.segment_weight_formula: w_i = 0.75 + 0.60*sin(pi*(i+0.5)/20), i=0..19; segment length = arc_total * w_i / sum(w). Mid-neck elongated per skeleton mounts (FARMS anatomy anchor).

joint_limits_deg.note: Two bend zones: forward bend low (throat, joints 1-6), backward bend high (kink behind head = strike hinge, joints 13-17). One documented revision during construction (before any gate measurement): deepest measured coils accumulate ~300-340 deg of turning; mid joints carry ~18-22 deg in the reversals' tails, so the first-draft mid cap of 16 made the canon coil unreachable by construction. Poses are authored to <=90% of cap.

neck_chain.root_anchor: Chain root = breast anchor ON the torso outline (the chest point of the approved strike still). First draft placed it 46 px inside the silhouette, which made the canon visible arc unreachable by construction; corrected before the gate. In folded poses the tube lies across the front of the breast, as the real neck does; the gate's neckbase = the tube/body junction as grounded on the mask.

width_profile_rest.note: Full tube width x torso, u = arc fraction from chain root. Base value from the approved stills (measure_stills instrument): rest 0.117, strike 0.0695 at the base station.

slimming_field_at_full_extension.note: Multiplier on the rest width profile at the standing strike peak. Base 0.595 = approved stills' own strike/rest base ratio; mid 0.58 (drawings 0.59 / bird 0.57); tip 0.62.

eye_anchor_in_head_frame.note: Derived from the approved strike still (eye vs skull/bill geometry, stills_results.json); validated to ~0.016 torso on that still. The eye anchor is part of the head assembly geometry on every pose (spike-3 finding: the drawn eye silently never drew in the fill spikes - the anchor must exist here).

poses.note: Each pose = heading profile knots (s = chain arc fraction, theta = heading degrees, screen coords: 0 = forward, +90 = down, -90 = up), PCHIP-interpolated; segment headings from the profile. Head pitch offset rotates the head assembly beyond the final segment heading.

legs.status: CORRECTED 2026-11-04 (post-reset; Jimmy approved the design gate 2026-11-04). Source: art2/art-design/LEG_CANON.md, measured off real GBH frames (qpYk f0028 coil + f0037 peak, same bird; 6bc stand; vanord underwater structure). Traces live in rig_v25.py as LEGS_BY_POSE, computed from these bands — not traced from any image.
legs.convention: Fractions along the torso over the loop x-extent (125-605 px, span 480); segment lengths x torso at the gate constant T = 496.3 px. A leg is a 3-point articulated chain (emergence -> intertarsal joint -> foot), configured PER POSE. The waterline crosses each leg exactly AT the intertarsal joint; on the 1024x600 mechanism canvas both joints sit at y = 382 and both feet on the ground line y = 486.

segments_exposed.lower_joint_to_foot: 0.17-0.22 band; traces built at 0.210 (LEG_CANON sec.2.3, the GBH same-bird split 0.214/0.215)
segments_exposed.note: GBH segment split rests on n=1 clean frame; the pooled band stands (LEG_CANON sec.3 GAP). The femur is inside the body plumage — never a visible segment; the thigh mass is rusty body plumage and the leg emerges from the thigh pockets at 0.53-0.61 along the torso. Lower leg stilt-thin (render widths hip->joint 16->11 px, joint->foot 7->5 px, kept).

alert.flag: Standing band — no alert-specific leg frame has been measured (LEG_CANON sec.3 GAP). The first alert plate drawn under the design is checked against this band.

strike_peak.note: Feet stay planted (centre moves 0.55 -> 0.50 coil to peak, within read noise); the body pitches over them and the legs slant BACK from emergence to feet by ~0.11 of span; stagger widens 0.14 -> 0.19 class. Peak segment lengths use the standing band (f0037 joint read unstable — LEG_CANON sec.3 GAP); placement is measured and solid.

legs.what_was_wrong: The retired traces (one pair, all poses, traced from a pre-reset still): feet-centre 0.285 vs the real bird's 0.50-0.55 (feet ~a quarter of the body too far toward the tail; mask-measured 0.284, identical on all three pose masks); emergence 0.22/0.35 vs 0.53-0.61 (the whole leg apparatus hung too far back); upper segment ~correct (0.20-0.21), lower segment 0.235-0.243 vs 0.215 (+0.02 to +0.07 too long); total 0.44-0.46 vs 0.42-0.44; and NO pose dependence — at peak the old feet kept the alert stance while the bird pitched, the error Jimmy spotted in the gate overlays and again in the warp-spike peak frame.

Joint caps FROZEN (throat 26 / mid 20 / hinge 30 / distal 22); the new coil's maxima: throat 22.1, mid 19.6, hinge 27.6, distal 20.8 - all legal. Alert and strike_peak poses untouched.
